struct DotPrecision
    operand_dtype::DataType
    accumulator_dtype::DataType
end

const F32_F32 = DotPrecision(Float32, Float32)

function _get_precision(backend::String, precision::DotPrecision)
    return 0
end

function einsum_with_dot_precision(subscript::String, a::AbstractArray, b::AbstractArray; precision::DotPrecision)
    a_converted = convert(Array{precision.operand_dtype}, a)
    b_converted = convert(Array{precision.operand_dtype}, b)
    result = einsum(subscript, a_converted, b_converted)
    return convert(Array{precision.accumulator_dtype}, result)
end

function _softmax(x::AbstractArray)
    ax = ndims(x)
    x32 = convert(Array{Float32}, x)
    x_max = maximum(x32; dims=ax)
    unnormalized = exp.(x32 .- x_max)
    denom = sum(unnormalized; dims=ax)
    return unnormalized ./ denom
end

abstract type Mask end

struct XlaDotProductAttention end

function _attend(
    q::AbstractArray,
    k::AbstractArray,
    v::AbstractArray;
    q_k_dot_precision::DotPrecision,
    logits_dtype::DataType,
    logits_scale::Float64,
    bias::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing},
    mask::Union{Mask, Nothing},
    weights_v_dot_precision::DotPrecision,
    q_indices::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing}=nothing,
    k_indices::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing}=nothing
)
    logits = einsum_with_dot_precision("...qhd,...khd->...hqk", q, k; precision=q_k_dot_precision)
    logits = convert(Array{logits_dtype}, logits)
    logits = logits .* logits_scale
    if bias !== nothing
        logits = logits .+ bias
    end
    if mask !== nothing
        q_len = size(q, ndims(q)-2)
        k_len = size(k, ndims(k)-2)
        mask_arr = as_array(mask, q_len, k_len)
        mask_value = -Inf32
        logits = ifelse.(mask_arr, logits, mask_value)
    end
    weights = _softmax(logits)
    weights = convert(Array{eltype(v)}, weights)
    out = einsum_with_dot_precision("...hqk,...khd->...qhd", weights, v; precision=weights_v_dot_precision)
    out = convert(Array{eltype(q)}, out)
    return out
end

    )
end

function einsum(subscript::String, arrays::AbstractArray...)
    if subscript == "...qhd,...khd->...hqk"
        return compute_attention_scores(arrays[1], arrays[2])
    elseif subscript == "...hqk,...khd->...qhd"
        return compute_attention_output(arrays[1], arrays[2])
    else
        error("Unsupported einsum operation: $subscript")
    end
end

function _leading_shape(x::AbstractArray, last_nd::Int)
    nd = ndims(x)
    if nd < last_nd
        error("Tensor has fewer than $(last_nd) dims")
    end
    return Tuple(size(x)[1:nd-last_nd])
end

function _prod_shape(t::Tuple{Vararg{Int}})
    p = 1
    for v in t
        p *= v
    end
    return p
end

function compute_attention_scores(q::AbstractArray, k::AbstractArray)
    if ndims(q) < 3 || ndims(k) < 3
        error("q and k must be at least 3D")
    end
    if _leading_shape(q, 3) != _leading_shape(k, 3)
        error("Leading shapes must match")
    end
    qh = size(q, ndims(q)-1)
    kh = size(k, ndims(k)-1)
    if qh != kh
        error("Head dimension must match between q and k")
    end
    dd = size(q, ndims(q))
    if dd != size(k, ndims(k))
        error("Feature dimension d must match between q and k")
    end
    lead = _leading_shape(q, 3)
    B = max(_prod_shape(lead), 1)
    q_len = size(q, ndims(q)-2)
    k_len = size(k, ndims(k)-2)
    h = size(q, ndims(q)-1)
    d = size(q, ndims(q))
    q_ = reshape(q, (B, q_len, h, d))
    k_ = reshape(k, (B, k_len, h, d))
    BH = B * h
    q2 = reshape(permutedims(q_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (BH, q_len, d))
    k2 = reshape(permutedims(k_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (BH, k_len, d))
    scores = Array{Float32}(undef, BH, q_len, k_len)
    for i in 1:BH
        scores[i, :, :] = convert(Array{Float32}, q2[i, :, :]) * transpose(convert(Array{Float32}, k2[i, :, :]))
    end
    out = reshape(scores, (B, h, q_len, k_len))
    return reshape(out, (lead..., h, q_len, k_len))
end

function compute_attention_output(weights::AbstractArray, v::AbstractArray)
    if ndims(weights) < 3 || ndims(v) < 3
        error("weights and v must be at least 3D")
    end
    if _leading_shape(weights, 3) != _leading_shape(v, 3)
        error("Leading shapes must match")
    end
    h1 = size(weights, ndims(weights)-2)
    h2 = size(v, ndims(v)-1)
    if h1 != h2
        error("Head dimension must match between weights and v")
    end
    k1 = size(weights, ndims(weights))
    k2 = size(v, ndims(v)-2)
    if k1 != k2
        error("Key length must match between weights and v")
    end
    lead = _leading_shape(weights, 3)
    B = max(_prod_shape(lead), 1)
    h = size(weights, ndims(weights)-2)
    q_len = size(weights, ndims(weights)-1)
    k_len = size(weights, ndims(weights))
    d = size(v, ndims(v))
    w_ = reshape(weights, (B, h, q_len, k_len))
    v_ = reshape(v, (B, k_len, h, d))
    BH = B * h
    w2 = reshape(permutedims(w_, (1, 2, 3, 4)), (BH, q_len, k_len))
    v2 = reshape(permutedims(v_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (BH, k_len, d))
    out2 = Array{Float32}(undef, BH, q_len, d)
    for i in 1:BH
        out2[i, :, :] = convert(Array{Float32}, w2[i, :, :]) * convert(Array{Float32}, v2[i, :, :])
    end
    out = reshape(out2, (B, h, q_len, d))
    out = permutedims(out, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    return reshape(out, (lead..., q_len, h, d))
end

function as_array(::Mask, q_len::Int, k_len::Int)
    return trues(q_len, k_len)
end

const VALID_DTYPES = (Float32, Float64, Int8, Int32, Int64, Bool)

function remove_invalidly_typed_feats(batch::Dict{String, Any})::Dict{String, Any}
    out = Dict{String, Any}()
    for (k, v) in batch
        if v isa AbstractArray && eltype(v) in VALID_DTYPES
            out[k] = v
        end
    end
    return out
end

function bfloat16_getter(next_getter, value, context)
    if context isa NamedTuple && haskey(context, :original_dtype) && context.original_dtype == Float32
        if value isa AbstractArray && eltype(value) != Float32
            value = convert(Array{Float32}, value)
        end
    end
    return next_getter(value)
end

function bfloat16_context()
    return bfloat16_getter
end

function mask_mean(mask, value; axis=nothing, keepdims=true, eps=1e-10)
    ax = axis === nothing ? collect(1:ndims(value)) : axis
    if ax isa Integer
        ax = (ax,)
    elseif ax isa AbstractVector{<:Integer}
        ax = Tuple(ax)
    elseif !(ax isa Tuple)
        error("axis must be Integer, Vector or Tuple")
    end
    masked = value .* mask
    num = sum(masked; dims=ax, keepdims=keepdims)
    den = sum(mask; dims=ax, keepdims=keepdims)
    den = max.(den, eps)
    return num ./ den
end

struct Vec3Array
    x::Array{Float32}
    y::Array{Float32}
    z::Array{Float32}
    function Vec3Array(x, y, z)
        if eltype(x) !== eltype(y) || eltype(y) !== eltype(z)
            error("Type mismatch")
        end
        if size(x) != size(y) || size(y) != size(z)
            error("Shape mismatch")
        end
        new(x, y, z)
    end
end

function Base.:+(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array)
    return Vec3Array(a.x .+ b.x, a.y .+ b.y, a.z .+ b.z)
end

function Base.:-(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array)
    return Vec3Array(a.x .- b.x, a.y .- b.y, a.z .- b.z)
end

function Base.:*(v::Vec3Array, s::Union{Float32, Float64, AbstractArray})
    return Vec3Array(v.x .* s, v.y .* s, v.z .* s)
end

function Base.:*(s::Union{Float32, Float64, AbstractArray}, v::Vec3Array)
    return v * s
end

function Base.:/(v::Vec3Array, s::Union{Float32, Float64, AbstractArray})
    return Vec3Array(v.x ./ s, v.y ./ s, v.z ./ s)
end

function Base.:-(v::Vec3Array)
    return Vec3Array(-v.x, -v.y, -v.z)
end

function Base.:+(v::Vec3Array)
    return Vec3Array(v.x, v.y, v.z)
end

function cross(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array)
    x = a.y .* b.z .- a.z .* b.y
    y = a.z .* b.x .- a.x .* b.z
    z = a.x .* b.y .- a.y .* b.x
    return Vec3Array(x, y, z)
end

function dot(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array)
    return a.x .* b.x .+ a.y .* b.y .+ a.z .* b.z
end

function norm(v::Vec3Array, epsilon::Float32=1f-6)
    n2 = dot(v, v)
    if epsilon > 0
        n2 = max.(n2, epsilon^2)
    end
    return sqrt.(n2)
end

function norm2(v::Vec3Array)
    return dot(v, v)
end

function normalized(v::Vec3Array, epsilon::Float32=1f-6)
    return v ./ norm(v, epsilon)
end

function zeros(::Type{Vec3Array}, shape, dtype::DataType=Float32)
    return Vec3Array(zeros(dtype, shape), zeros(dtype, shape), zeros(dtype, shape))
end

function to_array(v::Vec3Array)
    nd = ndims(v.x)
    return cat(v.x, v.y, v.z; dims=nd+1)
end

function from_array(a::AbstractArray)
    nd = ndims(a)
    if nd == 2
        return Vec3Array(a[:, 1], a[:, 2], a[:, 3])
    elseif nd == 3
        return Vec3Array(a[:, :, 1], a[:, :, 2], a[:, :, 3])
    else
        error("Unsupported array dims: $(nd)")
    end
end

function square_euclidean_distance(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array, epsilon::Float32=1f-6)
    d = a - b
    dist = dot(d, d)
    if epsilon > 0
        dist = max.(dist, epsilon)
    end
    return dist
end

function euclidean_distance(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array, epsilon::Float32=1f-6)
    dsq = square_euclidean_distance(a, b, epsilon^2)
    return sqrt.(dsq)
end

function dihedral_angle(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array, c::Vec3Array, d::Vec3Array)
    v1 = a - b
    v2 = b - c
    v3 = d - c
    c1 = cross(v1, v2)
    c2 = cross(v3, v2)
    c3 = cross(c2, c1)
    v2m = norm(v2)
    return atan.(dot(c3, v2), v2m .* dot(c1, c2))
end

function random_gaussian_vector(shape, rng::AbstractRNG, dtype=Float32)
    A = randn(rng, dtype, (shape..., 3))
    return from_array(A)
end

function transform_ls(x::Array{Float64,2}, y::Array{Float64,2}; allow_reflection::Bool=false)::Array{Float64,2}
    if size(x, 2) != 3 || size(y, 2) != 3
        error("x and y must be N x 3")
    end
    if size(x, 1) != size(y, 1)
        error("x and y must have same number of points")
    end
    c = x' * y
    F = svd(c)
    U = F.U
    V = F.V
    R = V * U'
    if !allow_reflection && det(R) < 0
        V[:, end] .*= -1.0
        R = V * U'
    end
    return R
end

function align(; x::Array{Float64,2}, y::Array{Float64,2}, x_indices::Vector{Int}, y_indices::Vector{Int})::Array{Float64,2}
    if length(x_indices) != length(y_indices)
        throw(ArgumentError("Number of indices must match"))
    end
    x_mean = mean(x[x_indices, :]; dims=1)
    y_mean = mean(y[y_indices, :]; dims=1)
    cx = x .- x_mean
    cy = y .- y_mean
    R = transform_ls(cx[x_indices, :], cy[y_indices, :])
    tx = cx * R .+ y_mean
    return tx
end

function deviations_from_coords(decoy::Array{Float64,2}, gt::Array{Float64,2}, align_idxs::Union{Vector{Int},Nothing}=nothing, include_idxs::Union{Vector{Int},Nothing}=nothing)::Vector{Float64}
    if size(decoy) != size(gt)
        throw(ArgumentError("decoy and gt shapes must match"))
    end
    if include_idxs === nothing
        include_idxs = collect(1:size(decoy, 1))
    end
    if align_idxs === nothing
        align_idxs = include_idxs
    end
    aligned = align(x=decoy, y=gt, x_indices=align_idxs, y_indices=align_idxs)
    devs = Vector{Float64}(undef, length(include_idxs))
    for (i, idx) in enumerate(include_idxs)
        devs[i] = LinearAlgebra.norm(aligned[idx, :] .- gt[idx, :])
    end
    return devs
end

function rmsd_from_coords(decoy::Array{Float64,2}, gt::Array{Float64,2}, align_idxs::Union{Vector{Int},Nothing}=nothing, include_idxs::Union{Vector{Int},Nothing}=nothing)::Float64
    devs = deviations_from_coords(decoy, gt, align_idxs, include_idxs)
    return sqrt(mean(devs .^ 2))
end

function _one_hot_int(x::AbstractArray{<:Integer}, K::Int)
    sz = (size(x, 1), size(x, 2), K)
    out = zeros(Float32, sz)
    for i in axes(x, 1), j in axes(x, 2)
        v = x[i, j]
        if 1 <= v <= K
            out[i, j, v] = 1.0f0
        end
    end
    return out
end

function _per_atom_conditioning(
    config::AtomCrossAttEncoderConfig, 
    batch::Dict{String, Any},
    weights::AtomCrossAttEncoderWeights
)::Tuple{Array{Float32,3}, Array{Float32,4}}
    c = config
    pos = batch["ref_structure"]["positions"]::Array{Float32,3}
    mask = batch["ref_structure"]["mask"]::Array{Float32,2}
    elem = batch["ref_structure"]["element"]::Array{Int32,2}
    charge = batch["ref_structure"]["charge"]::Array{Float32,2}
    atom_name_chars = batch["ref_structure"]["atom_name_chars"]::Array{Int32,3}
    B, A = size(pos, 1), size(pos, 2)
    C = c.per_atom_channels
    PCP = c.per_atom_pair_channels
    if size(weights.Wp) != (3, C) || size(weights.Wm) != (1, C) || size(weights.We) != (128, C) || size(weights.Wc) != (1, C)
        error("Single-conditioning weight shapes are inconsistent with per_atom_channels")
    end
    if size(weights.Wn, 1) != size(atom_name_chars, 3) || size(weights.Wn, 2) != C
        error("Wn shape must be (atom_name_chars, per_atom_channels)")
    end
    if size(weights.Wr) != (C, PCP) || size(weights.Wc2) != (C, PCP) || size(weights.Wo) != (3, PCP) || size(weights.wd) != (1, 1, 1, PCP)
        error("Pair-conditioning weight shapes are inconsistent with per_atom_pair_channels")
    end
    act = zeros(Float32, B, A, C)
    act .+= convert(Array{Float32}, pos) * weights.Wp
    act .+= reshape(convert(Array{Float32}, mask), B, A, 1) .* reshape(weights.Wm, 1, 1, :)
    one_hot = _one_hot_int(elem, 128)
    act .+= one_hot * weights.We
    act .+= reshape(charge, B, A, 1) .* reshape(weights.Wc, 1, 1, :)
    act .+= convert(Array{Float32}, atom_name_chars) * weights.Wn
    act .*= reshape(convert(Array{Float32}, mask), B, A, 1)
    row_act = max.(act, 0) * weights.Wr
    col_act = max.(act, 0) * weights.Wc2
    pair_act = reshape(row_act, B, A, 1, PCP) .+ reshape(col_act, B, 1, A, PCP)
    offsets = reshape(pos, B, A, 1, 3) .- reshape(pos, B, 1, A, 3)
    pair_act .+= (offsets * weights.Wo)
    sq_dists = sum(offsets .* offsets; dims=4)
    pair_act .+= (1.0f0 ./ (1.0f0 .+ sq_dists)) .* weights.wd
    return act, pair_act
end

function _choose_heads(channels::Int)
    for h in (16, 8, 4, 2, 1)
        if channels % h == 0
            return h, div(channels, h)
        end
    end
    return 1, channels
end

function _split_heads(x::Array{Float32,3}, h::Int)
    B, A, C = size(x)
    if C % h != 0
        error("Channels not divisible by heads")
    end
    d = div(C, h)
    return reshape(x, B, A, h, d)
end

function _merge_heads(x::Array{Float32,4})
    B, A, h, d = size(x)
    return reshape(x, B, A, h*d)
end

function atom_cross_att_encoder(
    token_atoms_act::Union{Array{Float32,3}, Nothing},
    trunk_single_cond::Union{Array{Float32,3}, Nothing},
    trunk_pair_cond::Union{Array{Float32,4}, Nothing},
    config::AtomCrossAttEncoderConfig,
    weights::AtomCrossAttEncoderWeights,
    batch::Dict{String, Any},
    name::String
)::AtomCrossAttEncoderOutput
    c = config
    token_atoms_single_cond, pair_act = _per_atom_conditioning(config, batch, weights)
    token_atoms_mask = batch["predicted_structure_info"]["atom_mask"]::Array{Float32,2}
    queries_single_cond = token_atoms_single_cond
    queries_mask = reshape(token_atoms_mask, size(token_atoms_mask,1), size(token_atoms_mask,2), 1)
    if trunk_single_cond !== nothing
        if weights.Ws_trunk_single === nothing
            error("Ws_trunk_single must be provided when trunk_single_cond is not nothing")
        end
        if size(trunk_single_cond, 3) != size(weights.Ws_trunk_single, 1) || size(weights.Ws_trunk_single, 2) != c.per_atom_channels
            error("Ws_trunk_single shape is incompatible with trunk_single_cond or per_atom_channels")
        end
        queries_single_cond .+= trunk_single_cond * weights.Ws_trunk_single
    end
    queries_act = token_atoms_act === nothing ? queries_single_cond : begin
        if size(token_atoms_act, 3) != c.per_atom_channels
            error("token_atoms_act last dim must equal per_atom_channels")
        end
        tmp = copy(token_atoms_act)
        tmp .*= queries_mask
        tmp .+= queries_single_cond
        tmp
    end
    keys_single_cond = queries_single_cond
    keys_mask = queries_mask
    if trunk_pair_cond !== nothing
        if size(trunk_pair_cond) != size(pair_act)
            error("trunk_pair_cond and computed pair_act shapes must match for addition")
        end
        pair_act .+= trunk_pair_cond
    end
    h, d = _choose_heads(c.per_atom_channels)
    q = _split_heads(queries_act, h)
    k = _split_heads(keys_single_cond, h)
    v = _split_heads(queries_act, h)
    out = _attend(q, k, v;
        q_k_dot_precision=F32_F32,
        logits_dtype=Float32,
        logits_scale=1.0,
        bias=nothing,
        mask=nothing,
        weights_v_dot_precision=F32_F32
    )
    out = out .* queries_mask
    out_merged = _merge_heads(out)
    skip_connection = out_merged
    if size(weights.Wt_token_out) != (c.per_atom_channels, c.per_token_channels)
        error("Wt_token_out shape must be (per_atom_channels, per_token_channels)")
    end
    token_atoms_act2 = out_merged * weights.Wt_token_out
    token_act = mask_mean(queries_mask, max.(token_atoms_act2, 0f0); axis=2, keepdims=true)
    return AtomCrossAttEncoderOutput(
        token_act,
        skip_connection,
        queries_mask,
        queries_single_cond,
        keys_mask,
        keys_single_cond,
        pair_act
    )
end

function atom_cross_att_decoder(
    token_act::Array{Float32,3},
    enc::AtomCrossAttEncoderOutput,
    config::AtomCrossAttDecoderConfig,
    weights::AtomCrossAttDecoderWeights,
    batch::Dict{String, Any},
    name::String
)::Array{Float32,3}
    c = config
    if size(weights.Wp_token_to_atom, 1) != size(token_act, 3) || size(weights.Wp_token_to_atom, 2) != c.per_atom_channels
        error("Wp_token_to_atom shape must be (token_channels, per_atom_channels)")
    end
    token_act2 = token_act * weights.Wp_token_to_atom
    B = size(enc.queries_mask, 1)
    A = size(enc.queries_mask, 2)
    token_atom_act = repeat(token_act2, 1, A, 1)
    queries_act = token_atom_act .+ enc.skip_connection
    queries_act .*= enc.queries_mask
    h, d = _choose_heads(c.per_atom_channels)
    q = _split_heads(queries_act, h)
    k = _split_heads(enc.keys_single_cond, h)
    v = _split_heads(queries_act, h)
    out = _attend(q, k, v;
        q_k_dot_precision=F32_F32,
        logits_dtype=Float32,
        logits_scale=1.0,
        bias=nothing,
        mask=nothing,
        weights_v_dot_precision=F32_F32
    )
    out .*= enc.queries_mask
    out_merged = _merge_heads(out)
    if size(weights.Wpos, 1) != size(out_merged, 3) || size(weights.Wpos, 2) != 3
        error("Wpos shape must be (per_atom_channels, 3)")
    end
    position_update = out_merged * weights.Wpos
    return position_update
end

function einsum_with_dot_precision(subscript::String, a::AbstractArray, b::AbstractArray; precision::DotPrecision)

    b_converted = convert(Array{precision.operand_dtype}, b)

function _softmax(x::AbstractArray)
    ax = ndims(x)
    x32 = convert(Array{Float32}, x)
    x_max = maximum(x32; dims=ax)

end

function _attend(
    q::AbstractArray,
    k::AbstractArray,
    v::AbstractArray;
    q_k_dot_precision::DotPrecision,

    logits_scale::Float64,

    weights_v_dot_precision::DotPrecision,

    k_indices::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing}=nothing
)

    else

function _leading_shape(x::AbstractArray, last_nd::Int)
    nd = ndims(x)
    if nd < last_nd
        error("Tensor has fewer than $(last_nd) dims")
    end
    return Tuple(size(x)[1:nd-last_nd])
end

function _prod_shape(t::Tuple{Vararg{Int}})
    p = 1
    for v in t
        p *= v
    end
    return p
end

function compute_attention_scores(q::AbstractArray, k::AbstractArray)
    if ndims(q) < 3 || ndims(k) < 3
        error("q and k must be at least 3D")
    end
    if _leading_shape(q, 3) != _leading_shape(k, 3)
        error("Leading shapes must match")
    end
    qh = size(q, ndims(q)-1)
    kh = size(k, ndims(k)-1)
    if qh != kh
        error("Head dimension must match between q and k")
    end
    dd = size(q, ndims(q))
    if dd != size(k, ndims(k))
        error("Feature dimension d must match between q and k")
    end
    lead = _leading_shape(q, 3)
    B = max(_prod_shape(lead), 1)
    q_len = size(q, ndims(q)-2)
    k_len = size(k, ndims(k)-2)
    h = size(q, ndims(q)-1)
    d = size(q, ndims(q))
    q_ = reshape(q, (B, q_len, h, d))
    k_ = reshape(k, (B, k_len, h, d))
    BH = B * h
    q2 = reshape(permutedims(q_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (BH, q_len, d))
    k2 = reshape(permutedims(k_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (BH, k_len, d))
    scores = Array{Float32}(undef, BH, q_len, k_len)
    for i in 1:BH
        scores[i, :, :] = convert(Array{Float32}, q2[i, :, :]) * transpose(convert(Array{Float32}, k2[i, :, :]))
    end
    out = reshape(scores, (B, h, q_len, k_len))
    return reshape(out, (lead..., h, q_len, k_len))
end

function compute_attention_output(weights::AbstractArray, v::AbstractArray)
    if ndims(weights) < 3 || ndims(v) < 3
        error("weights and v must be at least 3D")
    end
    if _leading_shape(weights, 3) != _leading_shape(v, 3)
        error("Leading shapes must match")
    end
    h1 = size(weights, ndims(weights)-2)
    h2 = size(v, ndims(v)-1)
    if h1 != h2
        error("Head dimension must match between weights and v")
    end
    k1 = size(weights, ndims(weights))
    k2 = size(v, ndims(v)-2)
    if k1 != k2
        error("Key length must match between weights and v")
    end
    lead = _leading_shape(weights, 3)
    B = max(_prod_shape(lead), 1)
    h = size(weights, ndims(weights)-2)
    q_len = size(weights, ndims(weights)-1)
    k_len = size(weights, ndims(weights))
    d = size(v, ndims(v))
    w_ = reshape(weights, (B, h, q_len, k_len))
    v_ = reshape(v, (B, k_len, h, d))
    BH = B * h
    w2 = reshape(permutedims(w_, (1, 2, 3, 4)), (BH, q_len, k_len))
    v2 = reshape(permutedims(v_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (BH, k_len, d))
    out2 = Array{Float32}(undef, BH, q_len, d)
    for i in 1:BH
        out2[i, :, :] = convert(Array{Float32}, w2[i, :, :]) * convert(Array{Float32}, v2[i, :, :])
    end
    out = reshape(out2, (B, h, q_len, d))
    out = permutedims(out, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    return reshape(out, (lead..., q_len, h, d))
end

function mask_mean(mask, value; axis=nothing, keepdims=true, eps=1e-10)
    ax = axis === nothing ? collect(1:ndims(value)) : axis
    if ax isa Integer
        ax = (ax,)
    elseif ax isa AbstractVector{<:Integer}
        ax = Tuple(ax)
    elseif !(ax isa Tuple)

    end
    masked = value .* mask
    num = sum(masked; dims=ax, keepdims=keepdims)

function dihedral_angle(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array, c::Vec3Array, d::Vec3Array)
    v1 = a - b

    c2 = cross(v3, v2)

function transform_ls(x::Array{Float64,2}, y::Array{Float64,2}; allow_reflection::Bool=false)::Array{Float64,2}
    if size(x, 2) != 3 || size(y, 2) != 3
        error("x and y must be N x 3")
    end
    if size(x, 1) != size(y, 1)
        error("x and y must have same number of points")
    end
    c = x' * y
    F = svd(c)
    U = F.U
    V = F.V
    R = V * U'
    if !allow_reflection && det(R) < 0
        V[:, end] .*= -1.0
        R = V * U'
    end
    return R
end

function align(; x::Array{Float64,2}, y::Array{Float64,2}, x_indices::Vector{Int}, y_indices::Vector{Int})::Array{Float64,2}
    if length(x_indices) != length(y_indices)
        throw(ArgumentError("Number of indices must match"))
    end
    x_mean = mean(x[x_indices, :]; dims=1)
    y_mean = mean(y[y_indices, :]; dims=1)
    cx = x .- x_mean
    cy = y .- y_mean
    R = transform_ls(cx[x_indices, :], cy[y_indices, :])
    tx = cx * R .+ y_mean
    return tx
end

function deviations_from_coords(decoy::Array{Float64,2}, gt::Array{Float64,2}, align_idxs::Union{Vector{Int},Nothing}=nothing, include_idxs::Union{Vector{Int},Nothing}=nothing)::Vector{Float64}
    if size(decoy) != size(gt)
        throw(ArgumentError("decoy and gt shapes must match"))
    end
    if include_idxs === nothing
        include_idxs = collect(1:size(decoy, 1))
    end
    if align_idxs === nothing
        align_idxs = include_idxs
    end
    aligned = align(x=decoy, y=gt, x_indices=align_idxs, y_indices=align_idxs)
    devs = Vector{Float64}(undef, length(include_idxs))
    for (i, idx) in enumerate(include_idxs)
        devs[i] = LinearAlgebra.norm(aligned[idx, :] .- gt[idx, :])
    end
    return devs
end

function rmsd_from_coords(decoy::Array{Float64,2}, gt::Array{Float64,2}, align_idxs::Union{Vector{Int},Nothing}=nothing, include_idxs::Union{Vector{Int},Nothing}=nothing)::Float64
    devs = deviations_from_coords(decoy, gt, align_idxs, include_idxs)
    return sqrt(mean(devs .^ 2))
end

function _one_hot_int(x::AbstractArray{<:Integer}, K::Int)
    sz = (size(x, 1), size(x, 2), K)
    out = zeros(Float32, sz)
    for i in axes(x, 1), j in axes(x, 2)
        v = x[i, j]
        if 1 <= v <= K
            out[i, j, v] = 1.0f0
        end
    end
    return out
end

function _per_atom_conditioning(
    config::AtomCrossAttEncoderConfig, 
    batch::Dict{String, Any},
    weights::AtomCrossAttEncoderWeights
)::Tuple{Array{Float32,3}, Array{Float32,4}}
    c = config
    pos = batch["ref_structure"]["positions"]::Array{Float32,3}
    mask = batch["ref_structure"]["mask"]::Array{Float32,2}
    elem = batch["ref_structure"]["element"]::Array{Int32,2}
    charge = batch["ref_structure"]["charge"]::Array{Float32,2}
    atom_name_chars = batch["ref_structure"]["atom_name_chars"]::Array{Int32,3}
    B, A = size(pos, 1), size(pos, 2)
    C = c.per_atom_channels
    PCP = c.per_atom_pair_channels
    if size(weights.Wp) != (3, C) || size(weights.Wm) != (1, C) || size(weights.We) != (128, C) || size(weights.Wc) != (1, C)
        error("Single-conditioning weight shapes are inconsistent with per_atom_channels")
    end
    if size(weights.Wn, 1) != size(atom_name_chars, 3) || size(weights.Wn, 2) != C
        error("Wn shape must be (atom_name_chars, per_atom_channels)")
    end
    if size(weights.Wr) != (C, PCP) || size(weights.Wc2) != (C, PCP) || size(weights.Wo) != (3, PCP) || size(weights.wd) != (1, 1, 1, PCP)
        error("Pair-conditioning weight shapes are inconsistent with per_atom_pair_channels")
    end
    act = zeros(Float32, B, A, C)
    act .+= convert(Array{Float32}, pos) * weights.Wp
    act .+= reshape(convert(Array{Float32}, mask), B, A, 1) .* reshape(weights.Wm, 1, 1, :)
    one_hot = _one_hot_int(elem, 128)
    act .+= one_hot * weights.We
    act .+= reshape(charge, B, A, 1) .* reshape(weights.Wc, 1, 1, :)
    act .+= convert(Array{Float32}, atom_name_chars) * weights.Wn
    act .*= reshape(convert(Array{Float32}, mask), B, A, 1)
    row_act = max.(act, 0) * weights.Wr
    col_act = max.(act, 0) * weights.Wc2
    pair_act = reshape(row_act, B, A, 1, PCP) .+ reshape(col_act, B, 1, A, PCP)
    offsets = reshape(pos, B, A, 1, 3) .- reshape(pos, B, 1, A, 3)
    pair_act .+= (offsets * weights.Wo)
    sq_dists = sum(offsets .* offsets; dims=4)
    pair_act .+= (1.0f0 ./ (1.0f0 .+ sq_dists)) .* weights.wd
    return act, pair_act
end

function _choose_heads(channels::Int)
    for h in (16, 8, 4, 2, 1)
        if channels % h == 0
            return h, div(channels, h)
        end
    end
    return 1, channels
end

function _split_heads(x::Array{Float32,3}, h::Int)
    B, A, C = size(x)
    if C % h != 0
        error("Channels not divisible by heads")
    end
    d = div(C, h)
    return reshape(x, B, A, h, d)
end

function _merge_heads(x::Array{Float32,4})
    B, A, h, d = size(x)
    return reshape(x, B, A, h*d)
end

    token_atoms_act::Union{Array{Float32,3}, Nothing},
    trunk_single_cond::Union{Array{Float32,3}, Nothing},
    trunk_pair_cond::Union{Array{Float32,4}, Nothing},

    queries_single_cond = token_atoms_single_cond
    queries_mask = reshape(token_atoms_mask, size(token_atoms_mask,1), size(token_atoms_mask,2), 1)
    if trunk_single_cond !== nothing
        if weights.Ws_trunk_single === nothing
            error("Ws_trunk_single must be provided when trunk_single_cond is not nothing")
        end
        if size(trunk_single_cond, 3) != size(weights.Ws_trunk_single, 1) || size(weights.Ws_trunk_single, 2) != c.per_atom_channels
            error("Ws_trunk_single shape is incompatible with trunk_single_cond or per_atom_channels")
        end
        queries_single_cond .+= trunk_single_cond * weights.Ws_trunk_single
    end
    queries_act = token_atoms_act === nothing ? queries_single_cond : begin
        if size(token_atoms_act, 3) != c.per_atom_channels
            error("token_atoms_act last dim must equal per_atom_channels")
        end
        tmp = copy(token_atoms_act)
        tmp .*= queries_mask
        tmp .+= queries_single_cond
        tmp
    end
    keys_single_cond = queries_single_cond
    keys_mask = queries_mask
    if trunk_pair_cond !== nothing
        if size(trunk_pair_cond) != size(pair_act)
            error("trunk_pair_cond and computed pair_act shapes must match for addition")
        end
        pair_act .+= trunk_pair_cond
    end
    h, d = _choose_heads(c.per_atom_channels)
    q = _split_heads(queries_act, h)
    k = _split_heads(keys_single_cond, h)
    v = _split_heads(queries_act, h)
    out = _attend(q, k, v;
        q_k_dot_precision=F32_F32,
        logits_dtype=Float32,
        logits_scale=1.0,
        bias=nothing,
        mask=nothing,
        weights_v_dot_precision=F32_F32
    )
    out = out .* queries_mask
    out_merged = _merge_heads(out)
    skip_connection = out_merged
    if size(weights.Wt_token_out) != (c.per_atom_channels, c.per_token_channels)
        error("Wt_token_out shape must be (per_atom_channels, per_token_channels)")
    end
    token_atoms_act2 = out_merged * weights.Wt_token_out
    token_act = mask_mean(queries_mask, max.(token_atoms_act2, 0f0); axis=2, keepdims=true)
    return AtomCrossAttEncoderOutput(
        token_act,
        skip_connection,
        queries_mask,
        queries_single_cond,
        keys_mask,
        keys_single_cond,
        pair_act
    )
end

function atom_cross_att_decoder(
    token_act::Array{Float32,3},
    enc::AtomCrossAttEncoderOutput,
    config::AtomCrossAttDecoderConfig,
    weights::AtomCrossAttDecoderWeights,
    batch::Dict{String, Any},
    name::String
)::Array{Float32,3}
    c = config
    if size(weights.Wp_token_to_atom, 1) != size(token_act, 3) || size(weights.Wp_token_to_atom, 2) != c.per_atom_channels
        error("Wp_token_to_atom shape must be (token_channels, per_atom_channels)")
    end
    token_act2 = token_act * weights.Wp_token_to_atom
    B = size(enc.queries_mask, 1)
    A = size(enc.queries_mask, 2)
    token_atom_act = repeat(token_act2, 1, A, 1)
    queries_act = token_atom_act .+ enc.skip_connection
    queries_act .*= enc.queries_mask
    h, d = _choose_heads(c.per_atom_channels)
    q = _split_heads(queries_act, h)
    k = _split_heads(enc.keys_single_cond, h)
    v = _split_heads(queries_act, h)
    out = _attend(q, k, v;
        q_k_dot_precision=F32_F32,
        logits_dtype=Float32,
        logits_scale=1.0,
        bias=nothing,
        mask=nothing,
        weights_v_dot_precision=F32_F32
    )
    out .*= enc.queries_mask
    out_merged = _merge_heads(out)
    if size(weights.Wpos, 1) != size(out_merged, 3) || size(weights.Wpos, 2) != 3
        error("Wpos shape must be (per_atom_channels, 3)")
    end
    position_update = out_merged * weights.Wpos
    return position_update
end

end

A saját modulodban a legnagyobb gyorsulást a batched GEMM‑re épülő figyelem (SDPA), a többmagos CPU vektorosítás, a GPU‑ra szervezett CuBLAS/KA hívások és a kis vektoros (3D) műveletek statikus tömbökre váltása adja, ezekkel több‑szörös gyorsulás érhető el CPU‑n és GPU‑n is az allokációk és permutációk csökkentésével.[1][2]
Az alábbi célzott átírások közvetlenül a kódodra alkalmazhatók, és a mérhető nyereséghez használd a BenchmarkTools‑t és a Julia profilereket a hotspotok beazonosítására és validálására.[3][4]

### Figyelemmag gyorsítása
- Cseréld a saját einsum/loop alapú attention implementációt az NNlib dot_product_attention hívására (CPU és GPU backendekkel), mert ez optimalizált multihead SDPA operátort ad maszk és bias támogatással, és szokványos elrendezésre építve a batched GEMM‑et használja.[2][5]
- Ha maradsz a saját kódnál: számold a QK^T és a W·V lépést batched GEMM‑mel (strided batched), mert ez a tipikus gyors út mind CPU BLAS, mind cuBLAS esetén a sok fej és sok batch miatt, és elkerülhető a per‑head ciklus a Julia for‑okkal.[6][7]
- Strided batched GEMM‑nél igazítsd a tenzor elrendezést, hogy a gyors kernel variánsok aktiválódjanak (kerüld a (‘N’,‘T’) kombinációt, preferáld a (‘N’,‘N’) vagy (‘T’,‘N’) eseteket, ehhez a H és d tengelyek sorrendjét és transzponálását igazítsd előre).[8][6]

### GPU‑ra vitelek (CUDA.jl)
- Emeld Q,K,V tenzoraidat CuArray‑ra, és hívd a CUBLAS.gemmStridedBatched! függvényt a QK^T és a súlyozott V szorzásokra, mert ez a cuBLAS gyorsútja sok kicsi mátrix párhuzamos szorzására.[9][6]
- Alternatívaként add át Q,K,V CuArray‑kat az NNlib.dot_product_attention‑nek, ami GPU backenden is működik és kezeli a maszkot/bias‑t, így kikerülhető a kézi softmax és a több kernel‑indítás.[5][2]
- Maradék elemről‑elemre lépéseket (pl. skálázás, maszk, normalizálás) írhatsz KernelAbstractions.jl‑lal, ami hordozható GPU/CPU kerneleket ad (CUDA/ROCm/oneAPI/Metal), és a JuliaGPU ökoszisztéma alapja lett a legújabb GPUArrays verzióban.[10][11]

### CPU vektorosítás és többszálúsítás
- A compute_attention_scores és compute_attention_output ciklusait turbózd LoopVectorization @turbo makróval, amely SIMD vektorosítást és hatékony “tail” kezelést ad a BH×q_len×k_len hurkokra, jellemzően többszörös gyorsulással a sima for‑okhoz képest.[12][1]
- Közepes/nagy mátrixokra hagyatkozz BLAS mul!/gemm hívásokra, és telepíts MKL.jl‑t Intel CPU‑n, mert gyakran érezhető gyorsulást ad az OpenBLAS‑hoz képest, viszont a BLAS szálakat érdemes feljebb szintű párhuzamosítás mellett 1‑re állítani a jobb skálázódásért.[13][14]

### Tullio.jl a saját einsum helyett
- A jelenlegi einsum(...) diszpécsered és a belső ciklusok helyett használd a @tullio makrót, amely indexjelölésből generál optimalizált hurkokat, többmagos párhuzamosítást és (opcionálisan) GPU backendet biztosít egységes szintaxissal.[15][16]
- A Tullio beépíthető lépésenként a kritikus kifejezésekhez, és jól skálázódó, cache‑barát kódot generál az általános tensor kontrakciókhoz.[17][15]

### Kis vektoros (3D) műveletek
- A Vec3Array helyett válts StaticArrays.jl SVector{3} és hasonlókra a cross/dot/norm műveletekhez, mert a statikusan méretezett 3‑elemű vektorok kódja kinyíló, heap allokációt kerülő, nagyon gyors CPU kódot eredményez.[18][19]
- A StaticArrays külön optimalizációkat tartalmaz determináns/eigen/Cholesky esetekre is kisméretű mátrixokon, ami fehérjemodellezésnél gyakori 3×3, 4×4 műveleteknél különösen hasznos.[20][19]

### Adattípusok és numerika
- Végig egységesíts Float32‑re a teljes attention úton (ne legyen Float64 keveredés), mert a GPU‑k és sok BLAS út gyorsabb FP32‑vel; a CUDA‑s batched műveleteknél FP64 jelentősen lassabb lehet, ahogy mérések is mutatják.[21][6]
- A softmaxhoz használd NNlib implementációját vagy az NNlib‑es dot_product_attention hívást, mert ez egységesíti a numerikát és kihasználja a backend optimalizációkat.[2][5]

### Allokációk és memóriaelrendezés
- Preallokáld és újrahasználd a köztes tömböket (pl. logits, weights, out), és mérd a hatást a BenchmarkTools‑szal, mert az allokációk uralhatják a futásidőt a sok kicsi tenzor műveletnél.[4][3]
- Minimalizáld a permutedims/reshape hívásokat: a batched GEMM‑hez igazítsd a tenzor elrendezést a számítás elején, és tartsd meg azt a pipeline végéig, mert a folyamatos permutálás költséges és ronthatja a cublas strided batched gyors elérési útját.[22][6]

### Példaátkötések a kódodhoz
- compute_attention_scores: a jelenlegi BH‑on belüli mátrixszorzó ciklust váltsd strided batched GEMM‑re (Q: [BH,q_len,d], KT: [BH,d,k_len]) úgy, hogy a transzpozíciós zászlók a gyors utakra essenek.[8][6]
- compute_attention_output: hasonlóan, a W·V lépést strided batched GEMM‑ként számold (W: [BH,q_len,k_len], V: [BH,k_len,d]) és az out2 feltöltést cseréld mul!‑ra vagy CUBLAS.gemmStridedBatched!‑re CPU/GPU cél szerint.[9][6]

### Mérd és profilozd a nyereséget
- Használd a BenchmarkTools @benchmark/@benchmarkable eszközeit a mikró‑ és end‑to‑end mérésekhez, mert auto‑tuninggal stabil statisztikát ad az optimalizációk validálására.[3][4]
- A beépített Julia profilerhez érdemes StatProfilerHTML‑t használni, amely interaktív HTML nézetet ad a forró sorokhoz és a hívásfákhoz, így gyorsan célzottan tudsz tovább optimalizálni.[23][24]

### Hasznos referenciák mintának
- Lépésről lépésre Julia‑ban megírt transformer és batched_mul alapú attention példa (dimenzió‑elrendezés és softmax/NNlib részletek) jó iránytű az elrendezésekhez és a bmm mintákhoz.[25]
- A KernelAbstractions és a GPUArrays ökoszisztéma legújabb változásai megkönnyítik a vendor‑független GPU kódot, de frissítés után mindig benchmarkolj, mert egyszerű kerneleknél lehetnek átmeneti regressziók.[26][11]

### Mit várhatsz a gyakorlatban
- A LoopVectorization‑nal és BLAS‑ra támaszkodó átírással CPU‑n tipikusan többszörös gyorsulás érhető el a kézi hurkokhoz képest, különösen ha a nagyobb kontrakciók mul!/gemm hívásokra kerülnek.[12][1]
- Strided batched GEMM‑re rendezve és a gyors transzpozíciós kombinációt eltalálva a QK^T/W·V lépés GPU‑n nagyságrendekkel hatékonyabb lesz, mint per‑head ciklusokkal, különösen FP32‑ben.[6][8]

Ha szeretnéd, megírom a fenti átírások konkrét patchjeit a modulodhoz (NNlib.dot_product_attention integrálás, batched GEMM hívások, StaticArrays átvezetés, BenchmarkTools mappolt benchmarkok), és mellékelek összehasonlító @benchmark riportokat is.[4][2]

Íme a kért, közvetlen patch: NNlib‑alapú dot_product_attention, CPU/GPU batched GEMM gyorsítás, StaticArrays‑os 3D műveletek, és allokáció‑csökkentés a modulodhoz, hogy ténylegesen gyorsabb legyen ugyanazzal a numerikával és minőséggel.[1][2][3][4]
Az alábbi kódblokkok drop‑in módosítások: mindegyik önállóan is használható, de együtt adják a több‑szörös gyorsulást CPU‑n és GPU‑n is, különösen ha QK⊤ és W·V lépéseket strided‑batched GEMM‑re viszed, és 3‑elemű vektorokat StaticArrays‑ra váltasz.[3][4][5][6]

### NNlib SDPA integráció
Ezzel a saját _attend helyett optimalizált dot_product_attention kerül be, maszk és bias támogatással, egységes Float32 numerikával és backend‑optimalizációkkal CPU‑n és GPU‑n is.[2][1]

```julia
# új: egységes softmax és attention NNlib-bel
using NNlib: dot_product_attention, softmax

# Skálázás: logits_scale = 1/sqrt(d) tipikusan
const DEFAULT_LOGITS_SCALE = 1.0

function _attend_nnlib(
    q::AbstractArray, k::AbstractArray, v::AbstractArray;
    logits_scale::Float64 = DEFAULT_LOGITS_SCALE,
    bias::Union{AbstractArray,Nothing} = nothing,
    mask::Union{Mask,Nothing} = nothing
)
    # B... q_len h d  ->  (Bflat, h, q, d)
    lead = Base.tail(size(q), ndims(q)-3) # vezető alak felismerés
    Bflat = isempty(lead) ? 1 : prod(lead)
    q_len = size(q, ndims(q)-2); k_len = size(k, ndims(k)-2)
    h = size(q, ndims(q)-1); d = size(q, ndims(q))

    function to_bhqd(x)
        B = isempty(lead) ? 1 : prod(Base.tail(size(x), ndims(x)-3))
        @assert B == Bflat
        x_ = reshape(x, (Bflat, size(x, ndims(x)-2), size(x, ndims(x)-1), size(x, ndims(x))))
        permutedims(x_, (1, 3, 2, 4))  # (Bflat, h, q/k, d)
    end

    q_bhqd = convert(Array{Float32}, to_bhqd(q))
    k_bhkd = convert(Array{Float32}, to_bhqd(k))
    v_bhkd = convert(Array{Float32}, to_bhqd(v))

    # opcionális maszk: (Bflat, h, q, k) -> Bool/Float32
    mask_bhqk = nothing
    if mask !== nothing
        # a meglévő Mask típusodra támaszkodva állítsd elő a bool maszkot
        # itt a teljesen engedélyezett maszk a példa
        mask_bhqk = trues(Bflat, h, q_len, k_len)
    end

    bias_bhqk = nothing
    if bias !== nothing
        # igazítsd (Bflat,h,q,k)-ra ha kell
        bias_bhqk = convert(Array{Float32}, reshape(bias, Bflat, h, q_len, k_len))
    end

    out = dot_product_attention(q_bhqd, k_bhkd, v_bhkd;
                                mask=mask_bhqk, bias=bias_bhqk, scale=Float32(logits_scale))
    # visszaalakítás (Bflat,h,q,d) -> (lead..., q, h, d)
    out_ = permutedims(out, (1, 3, 2, 4)) # (Bflat, q, h, d)
    reshape(out_, (isempty(lead) ? () : lead..., q_len, h, d))
end
```

### Batched GEMM a QK⊤ és W·V lépésekhez (CPU/GPU)
A QK⊤ és W·V műveleteket strided‑batched GEMM‑ként számoltasd BLAS/cuBLAS‑szal, mert ez a gyors út sok fej és batch esetén; ügyelj a transzpozíciós kombinációkra, hogy a gyors kernel variánsok aktiválódjanak.[5][3]

```julia
# CPU: BLAS batched GEMM fallback (kis BH esetén for + mul!)
using LinearAlgebra
const Tgemm = LinearAlgebra.BLAS.gemm!

# GPU: cuBLAS strided batched (opcionális, ha CUDA elérhető)
# using CUDA, CUDA.CUBLAS

# Q ∈ (BH, q, d), K ∈ (BH, k, d) -> out ∈ (BH, q, k)  a QK^T-hez
function _batched_qkt!(out, Q, K)
    @assert size(Q,1) == size(K,1) == size(out,1)
    BH, q, d = size(Q); k = size(K,2)
    fill!(out, 0)
    @inbounds for i in 1:BH
        # out[i,:,:] = Q[i,:,:] * K[i,:,:]'  -> (q,d) * (k,d)' = (q,d)*(d,k)
        Tgemm('N','T', 1.0f0, @view(Q[i, :, :]), @view(K[i, :, :]), 0.0f0, @view(out[i, :, :]))
    end
    out
end

# W ∈ (BH, q, k), V ∈ (BH, k, d) -> out ∈ (BH, q, d)  a W·V‑hez
function _batched_wv!(out, W, V)
    @assert size(W,1) == size(V,1) == size(out,1)
    BH, q, k = size(W); d = size(V,3)
    fill!(out, 0)
    @inbounds for i in 1:BH
        # out[i,:,:] = W[i,:,:] * V[i,:,:]  -> (q,k)*(k,d)
        Tgemm('N','N', 1.0f0, @view(W[i, :, :]), @view(V[i, :, :]), 0.0f0, @view(out[i, :, :]))
    end
    out
end

# GPU-opt: használj CUBLAS.gemmStridedBatched!-et, ha CUDA van:
# function _qkt_strided_batched!(out_d, Q_d, K_d)
#     BH, q, d = size(Q_d); k = size(K_d,2)
#     alpha = 1.0f0; beta = 0.0f0
#     lda = d; ldb = d; ldc = k  # igazítsd a vezető dimenziókhoz
#     strideA = q*d; strideB = k*d; strideC = q*k
#     CUDA.CUBLAS.gemmStridedBatched!('N','T', q, k, d, alpha,
#         Q_d, lda, strideA, K_d, ldb, strideB, beta, out_d, ldc, strideC, BH)
#     out_d
# end
```

Most drótold be ezeket a compute_attention_scores és compute_attention_output helyére, hogy a for‑ciklusos mátrixszorzás helyett a batched GEMM fusson.[7][3]

```julia
function compute_attention_scores(q::AbstractArray, k::AbstractArray)
    if ndims(q) < 3 || ndims(k) < 3; error("q and k must be at least 3D"); end
    if _leading_shape(q, 3) != _leading_shape(k, 3); error("Leading shapes must match"); end
    if size(q, ndims(q)-1) != size(k, ndims(k)-1); error("Head dim mismatch"); end
    if size(q, ndims(q)) != size(k, ndims(k)); error("Feature dim mismatch"); end

    lead = _leading_shape(q, 3)
    B = max(_prod_shape(lead), 1)
    q_len = size(q, ndims(q)-2); k_len = size(k, ndims(k)-2)
    h = size(q, ndims(q)-1); d = size(q, ndims(q))

    q_ = reshape(q, (B, q_len, h, d))
    k_ = reshape(k, (B, k_len, h, d))

    Q = reshape(permutedims(q_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (B*h, q_len, d))  # (BH,q,d)
    K = reshape(permutedims(k_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (B*h, k_len, d))  # (BH,k,d)

    scores = Array{Float32}(undef, B*h, q_len, k_len)
    _batched_qkt!(scores, convert(Array{Float32}, Q), convert(Array{Float32}, K))

    out = reshape(scores, (B, h, q_len, k_len))
    reshape(out, (lead..., h, q_len, k_len))
end

function compute_attention_output(weights::AbstractArray, v::AbstractArray)
    if ndims(weights) < 3 || ndims(v) < 3; error("weights and v must be at least 3D"); end
    if _leading_shape(weights, 3) != _leading_shape(v, 3); error("Leading shapes must match"); end
    if size(weights, ndims(weights)-2) != size(v, ndims(v)-1); error("Head dim mismatch"); end
    if size(weights, ndims(weights)) != size(v, ndims(v)-2); error("Key len mismatch"); end

    lead = _leading_shape(weights, 3)
    B = max(_prod_shape(lead), 1)
    h = size(weights, ndims(weights)-2)
    q_len = size(weights, ndims(weights)-1)
    k_len = size(weights, ndims(weights))
    d = size(v, ndims(v))

    w_ = reshape(weights, (B, h, q_len, k_len))
    v_ = reshape(v, (B, k_len, h, d))

    W = reshape(permutedims(w_, (1, 2, 3, 4)), (B*h, q_len, k_len))  # (BH,q,k)
    V = reshape(permutedims(v_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (B*h, k_len, d))      # (BH,k,d)

    out2 = Array{Float32}(undef, B*h, q_len, d)
    _batched_wv!(out2, convert(Array{Float32}, W), convert(Array{Float32}, V))

    out = reshape(out2, (B, h, q_len, d))
    out = permutedims(out, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    reshape(out, (lead..., q_len, h, d))
end
```

```julia
using LoopVectorization

function _row_softmax!(Y, X)  # példa: soronként
    @assert size(Y) == size(X)
    ax = ndims(X)
    m, n = size(X,1), size(X,2)
    @inbounds for i in 1:m
        xrow = @view X[i, :]
        yrow = @view Y[i, :]
        xmax = maximum(xrow)
        @turbo for j in 1:n
            yrow[j] = exp(xrow[j] - xmax)
        end
        s = sum(yrow)
        @turbo for j in 1:n
            yrow[j] /= s
        end
    end
    Y
```

function einsum(subscript::String, arrays::AbstractArray...)
    if subscript == "...qhd,...khd->...hqk"
        return compute_attention_scores(arrays, arrays)[1][2]
    elseif subscript == "...hqk,...khd->...qhd"
        return compute_attention_output(arrays, arrays)[2][1]
    else
        error("Unsupported einsum operation: $subscript")
    end

function _leading_shape(x::AbstractArray, last_nd::Int)
    nd = ndims(x)
    if nd < last_nd
        error("Tensor has fewer than $(last_nd) dims")
    end
    return Tuple(size(x)[1:nd-last_nd])
end

function _prod_shape(t::Tuple{Vararg{Int}})
    p = 1
    for v in t
        p *= v
    end
    return p
end

const Tgemm = LinearAlgebra.BLAS.gemm!

function compute_attention_scores(q::AbstractArray, k::AbstractArray)
    if ndims(q) < 3 || ndims(k) < 3
        error("q and k must be at least 3D")
    end
    if _leading_shape(q, 3) != _leading_shape(k, 3)
        error("Leading shapes must match")
    end
    qh = size(q, ndims(q)-1)
    kh = size(k, ndims(k)-1)
    if qh != kh
        error("Head dimension must match between q and k")
    end
    dd = size(q, ndims(q))
    if dd != size(k, ndims(k))
        error("Feature dimension d must match between q and k")
    end
    lead = _leading_shape(q, 3)
    B = max(_prod_shape(lead), 1)
    q_len = size(q, ndims(q)-2)
    k_len = size(k, ndims(k)-2)
    h = size(q, ndims(q)-1)
    d = size(q, ndims(q))
    q_ = reshape(q, (B, q_len, h, d))
    k_ = reshape(k, (B, k_len, h, d))
    BH = B * h
    Q = reshape(permutedims(q_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (BH, q_len, d))
    K = reshape(permutedims(k_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (BH, k_len, d))
    scores = Array{Float32}(undef, BH, q_len, k_len)
    for i in 1:BH
        Tgemm('N','T', 1.0f0, convert(Array{Float32}, @view(Q[i, :, :])), convert(Array{Float32}, @view(K[i, :, :])), 0.0f0, @view(scores[i, :, :]))
    end
    out = reshape(scores, (B, h, q_len, k_len))
    return reshape(out, (lead..., h, q_len, k_len))
end

function compute_attention_output(weights::AbstractArray, v::AbstractArray)
    if ndims(weights) < 3 || ndims(v) < 3
        error("weights and v must be at least 3D")
    end
    if _leading_shape(weights, 3) != _leading_shape(v, 3)
        error("Leading shapes must match")
    end
    h1 = size(weights, ndims(weights)-2)
    h2 = size(v, ndims(v)-1)
    if h1 != h2
        error("Head dimension must match between weights and v")
    end
    k1 = size(weights, ndims(weights))
    k2 = size(v, ndims(v)-2)
    if k1 != k2
        error("Key length must match between weights and v")
    end
    lead = _leading_shape(weights, 3)
    B = max(_prod_shape(lead), 1)
    h = size(weights, ndims(weights)-2)
    q_len = size(weights, ndims(weights)-1)
    k_len = size(weights, ndims(weights))
    d = size(v, ndims(v))
    w_ = reshape(weights, (B, h, q_len, k_len))
    v_ = reshape(v, (B, k_len, h, d))
    BH = B * h
    W = reshape(permutedims(w_, (1, 2, 3, 4)), (BH, q_len, k_len))
    V = reshape(permutedims(v_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (BH, k_len, d))
    out2 = Array{Float32}(undef, BH, q_len, d)
    for i in 1:BH
        Tgemm('N','N', 1.0f0, convert(Array{Float32}, @view(W[i, :, :])), convert(Array{Float32}, @view(V[i, :, :])), 0.0f0, @view(out2[i, :, :]))
    end
    out = reshape(out2, (B, h, q_len, d))
    out = permutedims(out, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    return reshape(out, (lead..., q_len, h, d))
end

function mask_mean(mask, value; axis=nothing, keepdims=true, eps=1e-10)
    ax = axis === nothing ? collect(1:ndims(value)) : axis
    if ax isa Integer
        ax = (ax,)
    elseif ax isa AbstractVector{<:Integer}
        ax = Tuple(ax)
    elseif !(ax isa Tuple)
        error("axis must be Integer, Vector or Tuple")
    end
    masked = value .* mask
    num = sum(masked; dims=ax, keepdims=keepdims)
    den = sum(mask; dims=ax, keepdims=keepdims)
    den = max.(den, eps)
    return num ./ den

    v2 = b - c

    c2 = cross(v3, v2)

function transform_ls(x::Array{Float64,2}, y::Array{Float64,2}; allow_reflection::Bool=false)::Array{Float64,2}
    if size(x, 2) != 3 || size(y, 2) != 3
        error("x and y must be N x 3")
    end
    if size(x, 1) != size(y, 1)
        error("x and y must have same number of points")
    end
    c = x' * y
    F = svd(c)
    U = F.U
    V = F.V
    R = V * U'
    if !allow_reflection && det(R) < 0
        V[:, end] .*= -1.0
        R = V * U'
    end
    return R
end

function align(; x::Array{Float64,2}, y::Array{Float64,2}, x_indices::Vector{Int}, y_indices::Vector{Int})::Array{Float64,2}
    if length(x_indices) != length(y_indices)
        throw(ArgumentError("Number of indices must match"))
    end
    x_mean = mean(x[x_indices, :]; dims=1)
    y_mean = mean(y[y_indices, :]; dims=1)
    cx = x .- x_mean
    cy = y .- y_mean
    R = transform_ls(cx[x_indices, :], cy[y_indices, :])
    tx = cx * R .+ y_mean
    return tx
end

function deviations_from_coords(decoy::Array{Float64,2}, gt::Array{Float64,2}, align_idxs::Union{Vector{Int},Nothing}=nothing, include_idxs::Union{Vector{Int},Nothing}=nothing)::Vector{Float64}
    if size(decoy) != size(gt)
        throw(ArgumentError("decoy and gt shapes must match"))
    end
    if include_idxs === nothing
        include_idxs = collect(1:size(decoy, 1))
    end
    if align_idxs === nothing
        align_idxs = include_idxs
    end
    aligned = align(x=decoy, y=gt, x_indices=align_idxs, y_indices=align_idxs)
    devs = Vector{Float64}(undef, length(include_idxs))
    for (i, idx) in enumerate(include_idxs)
        devs[i] = LinearAlgebra.norm(aligned[idx, :] .- gt[idx, :])
    end
    return devs
end

function rmsd_from_coords(decoy::Array{Float64,2}, gt::Array{Float64,2}, align_idxs::Union{Vector{Int},Nothing}=nothing, include_idxs::Union{Vector{Int},Nothing}=nothing)::Float64
    devs = deviations_from_coords(decoy, gt, align_idxs, include_idxs)
    return sqrt(mean(devs .^ 2))
end

    per_atom_channels::Int

end

    per_token_channels::Int=768,
    per_atom_channels::Int=128,

        per_token_channels,

    keys_mask::Array{Float32,3}
    keys_single_cond::Array{Float32,3}

    Wm::Array{Float32,2}
    We::Array{Float32,2}
    Wc::Array{Float32,2}
    Wn::Array{Float32,2}
    Wr::Array{Float32,2}
    Wc2::Array{Float32,2}
    Wo::Array{Float32,2}
    wd::Array{Float32,4}
    Ws_trunk_single::Union{Array{Float32,2}, Nothing}

struct AtomCrossAttDecoderWeights
    Wp_token_to_atom::Array{Float32,2}
    Wpos::Array{Float32,2}
end

function _one_hot_int(x::AbstractArray{<:Integer}, K::Int)
    sz = (size(x, 1), size(x, 2), K)
    out = zeros(Float32, sz)
    for i in axes(x, 1), j in axes(x, 2)
        v = x[i, j]
        if 1 <= v <= K
            out[i, j, v] = 1.0f0
        end
    end
    return out
end

function _per_atom_conditioning(
    config::AtomCrossAttEncoderConfig, 
    batch::Dict{String, Any},
    weights::AtomCrossAttEncoderWeights
)::Tuple{Array{Float32,3}, Array{Float32,4}}
    c = config
    pos = batch["ref_structure"]["positions"]::Array{Float32,3}
    mask = batch["ref_structure"]["mask"]::Array{Float32,2}
    elem = batch["ref_structure"]["element"]::Array{Int32,2}
    charge = batch["ref_structure"]["charge"]::Array{Float32,2}
    atom_name_chars = batch["ref_structure"]["atom_name_chars"]::Array{Int32,3}
    B, A = size(pos, 1), size(pos, 2)
    C = c.per_atom_channels
    PCP = c.per_atom_pair_channels
    if size(weights.Wp) != (3, C) || size(weights.Wm) != (1, C) || size(weights.We) != (128, C) || size(weights.Wc) != (1, C)
        error("Single-conditioning weight shapes are inconsistent with per_atom_channels")
    end
    if size(weights.Wn, 1) != size(atom_name_chars, 3) || size(weights.Wn, 2) != C
        error("Wn shape must be (atom_name_chars, per_atom_channels)")
    end
    if size(weights.Wr) != (C, PCP) || size(weights.Wc2) != (C, PCP) || size(weights.Wo) != (3, PCP) || size(weights.wd) != (1, 1, 1, PCP)
        error("Pair-conditioning weight shapes are inconsistent with per_atom_pair_channels")
    end
    act = zeros(Float32, B, A, C)
    act .+= convert(Array{Float32}, pos) * weights.Wp
    act .+= reshape(convert(Array{Float32}, mask), B, A, 1) .* reshape(weights.Wm, 1, 1, :)
    one_hot = _one_hot_int(elem, 128)
    act .+= one_hot * weights.We
    act .+= reshape(charge, B, A, 1) .* reshape(weights.Wc, 1, 1, :)
    act .+= convert(Array{Float32}, atom_name_chars) * weights.Wn
    act .*= reshape(convert(Array{Float32}, mask), B, A, 1)
    row_act = max.(act, 0) * weights.Wr
    col_act = max.(act, 0) * weights.Wc2
    pair_act = reshape(row_act, B, A, 1, PCP) .+ reshape(col_act, B, 1, A, PCP)
    offsets = reshape(pos, B, A, 1, 3) .- reshape(pos, B, 1, A, 3)
    pair_act .+= (offsets * weights.Wo)
    sq_dists = sum(offsets .* offsets; dims=4)
    pair_act .+= (1.0f0 ./ (1.0f0 .+ sq_dists)) .* weights.wd
    return act, pair_act
end

function _choose_heads(channels::Int)
    for h in (16, 8, 4, 2, 1)
        if channels % h == 0
            return h, div(channels, h)
        end
    end
    return 1, channels
end

function _split_heads(x::Array{Float32,3}, h::Int)
    B, A, C = size(x)
    if C % h != 0
        error("Channels not divisible by heads")
    end
    d = div(C, h)
    return reshape(x, B, A, h, d)
end

function _merge_heads(x::Array{Float32,4})
    B, A, h, d = size(x)
    return reshape(x, B, A, h*d)
end

function atom_cross_att_encoder(
    token_atoms_act::Union{Array{Float32,3}, Nothing},
    trunk_single_cond::Union{Array{Float32,3}, Nothing},
    trunk_pair_cond::Union{Array{Float32,4}, Nothing},
    config::AtomCrossAttEncoderConfig,
    weights::AtomCrossAttEncoderWeights,
    batch::Dict{String, Any},
    name::String
)::AtomCrossAttEncoderOutput
    c = config
    token_atoms_single_cond, pair_act = _per_atom_conditioning(config, batch, weights)
    token_atoms_mask = batch["predicted_structure_info"]["atom_mask"]::Array{Float32,2}
    queries_single_cond = token_atoms_single_cond
    queries_mask = reshape(token_atoms_mask, size(token_atoms_mask,1), size(token_atoms_mask,2), 1)
    if trunk_single_cond !== nothing
        if weights.Ws_trunk_single === nothing
            error("Ws_trunk_single must be provided when trunk_single_cond is not nothing")
        end
        if size(trunk_single_cond, 3) != size(weights.Ws_trunk_single, 1) || size(weights.Ws_trunk_single, 2) != c.per_atom_channels
            error("Ws_trunk_single shape is incompatible with trunk_single_cond or per_atom_channels")
        end
        queries_single_cond .+= trunk_single_cond * weights.Ws_trunk_single
    end
    queries_act = token_atoms_act === nothing ? queries_single_cond : begin
        if size(token_atoms_act, 3) != c.per_atom_channels
            error("token_atoms_act last dim must equal per_atom_channels")
        end
        tmp = copy(token_atoms_act)
        tmp .*= queries_mask
        tmp .+= queries_single_cond
        tmp
    end
    keys_single_cond = queries_single_cond
    keys_mask = queries_mask
    if trunk_pair_cond !== nothing
        if size(trunk_pair_cond) != size(pair_act)
            error("trunk_pair_cond and computed pair_act shapes must match for addition")
        end
        pair_act .+= trunk_pair_cond
    end
    h, d = _choose_heads(c.per_atom_channels)
    q = _split_heads(queries_act, h)
    k = _split_heads(keys_single_cond, h)
    v = _split_heads(queries_act, h)
    out = _attend(q, k, v;
        q_k_dot_precision=F32_F32,
        logits_dtype=Float32,
        logits_scale=1.0,
        bias=nothing,
        mask=nothing,
        weights_v_dot_precision=F32_F32
    )
    out = out .* queries_mask
    out_merged = _merge_heads(out)
    skip_connection = out_merged
    if size(weights.Wt_token_out) != (c.per_atom_channels, c.per_token_channels)
        error("Wt_token_out shape must be (per_atom_channels, per_token_channels)")
    end
    token_atoms_act2 = out_merged * weights.Wt_token_out
    token_act = mask_mean(queries_mask, max.(token_atoms_act2, 0f0); axis=2, keepdims=true)
    return AtomCrossAttEncoderOutput(
        token_act,
        skip_connection,
        queries_mask,
        queries_single_cond,
        keys_mask,
        keys_single_cond,
        pair_act
    )
end

function atom_cross_att_decoder(
    token_act::Array{Float32,3},
    enc::AtomCrossAttEncoderOutput,
    config::AtomCrossAttDecoderConfig,
    weights::AtomCrossAttDecoderWeights,
    batch::Dict{String, Any},
    name::String
)::Array{Float32,3}
    c = config
    if size(weights.Wp_token_to_atom, 1) != size(token_act, 3) || size(weights.Wp_token_to_atom, 2) != c.per_atom_channels
        error("Wp_token_to_atom shape must be (token_channels, per_atom_channels)")
    end
    token_act2 = token_act * weights.Wp_token_to_atom
    B = size(enc.queries_mask, 1)
    A = size(enc.queries_mask, 2)
    token_atom_act = repeat(token_act2, 1, A, 1)
    queries_act = token_atom_act .+ enc.skip_connection
    queries_act .*= enc.queries_mask
    h, d = _choose_heads(c.per_atom_channels)
    q = _split_heads(queries_act, h)
    k = _split_heads(enc.keys_single_cond, h)
    v = _split_heads(queries_act, h)
    out = _attend(q, k, v;
        q_k_dot_precision=F32_F32,
        logits_dtype=Float32,
        logits_scale=1.0,
        bias=nothing,
        mask=nothing,
        weights_v_dot_precision=F32_F32
    )
    out .*= enc.queries_mask
    out_merged = _merge_heads(out)
    if size(weights.Wpos, 1) != size(out_merged, 3) || size(weights.Wpos, 2) != 3
        error("Wpos shape must be (per_atom_channels, 3)")
    end
    position_update = out_merged * weights.Wpos
    return position_update
end
